request: After the guide and visa icons became Galleria cartouches (#239), the owner sent a phone screenshot of the visa page with the burgundy notebook in its header: «Надо было заменить вот это блокнот, он как раз так и проблематичен». The topic pictures of guides and visa — the header of each guide, the catalogue tiles, the guide and visa roads and the visa point switcher — move to the same chosen style (round five, variant 7). The home page, the cabinet and the plan keep the shared object set (design/illustrations/objects-2026-11-13.json). Then, on why the first take differed from the approved variants («Почему это отличается от вариантов которые ты делал до этого и которые я одобрил»), the set was redone from the original variant 7 images, and on the small cartouches in the overview cells: «Убери эти мелкие гербы, они тут ни к чему, везде применяй этот принцип» — the picture is only large: the topic header, the catalogue tile, the visa point switcher. The road thumbs (56 px) keep the shared objects. On 19 Nov, on the catalogue tiles: the visa gets «флаг конкретный Казахстана» (kz-flag; the passport cartouche stays with the visa point about the passport), the DSU coins looked «слишком по-яичному» and became refined thin coins, the family documents lost the two odd columns for a family tree on papers; the document-check upload zone swapped its felt folder («чуть страшновата») for the doc-check cartouche. Then: «отчекань на монетах самого Веспи», «на визу D изобрази именно что паспорт Казахстана», «справки о семье переработай» — Vespi on the coin, the Kazakhstan passport for the visa topic and its passport point, a family cameo over a sealed certificate. Then, on the permesso tile: «сделай иконку пластиковой карточки пермессо с фоткой Веспи» (permesso-card; the crossed keys stay with the visa points about housing), and on the home scene «После визы путь продолжается»: «замени иконки… тоже» — its three cards (permesso, codice fiscale, insurance) show these cartouches.
model: Higgsfield gpt_image_2_6, quality high, 1k, 1:1, transparent background, with the three original variant 7 images as style references (not as a shape to copy): 73519f80-c62c-40fe-8e8b-80042bde86ef (coins), bb353c85-8c76-42c8-9c2a-e1cdeb39c24f (hourglass), addccab9-cbf8-4eb4-8f1e-9d7c7b9c44e3 (temple)
template: In the same style as the reference images, but do not copy their outline: draw a new Baroque strapwork cartouche of its own. In the style of the floor of the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan, polished marble tesserae, freshly laid, seen straight from above: a Baroque strapwork cartouche with a cream ivory ground laid in rows, its edges curling outward into rich slate-blue scrolled straps with ochre and terracotta inner bands, acanthus leaves in leaf green, crowned at the top by a terracotta and ochre scallop shell; no square, no circle. In the centre a flat symmetrical emblem laid in the same small tesserae as everything else, matte, no bevel, no gloss, no drop shadow, classical in form like the reference coins, hourglass and temple: {motif}. Palette: cream ivory, warm ochre, terracotta red, slate blue, leaf green. Flat, not a 3D object, not an emoji, not an app pictogram. Transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers.
processing: crop to alpha (>4 %), centred on a transparent square plus 6 px; master WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/cartouche/; site WebP q86 at 240 and 480 px (square), src/components/guides/guideArt.ts cartoucheFrame.
